missing_mapping: [{"instrument": "Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1774", "provision": "Article 28(5)", "reason": "This provision requires an internal audit of the ICT risk management framework in line with the financial entity's audit plan, with frequency commensurate to ICT risk, which directly supports the control statement.", "evidence_ids": ["eu-2024-1774-article-28-5"]}]
applicability_note: The control statement applies to the independent review of critical or important ICT services, which is a key requirement for financial entities under DORA.
challenge_comment: The existing mapping to Articles 8-9 of the 2024/1773 Regulation is incorrect. The control statement is supported by Article 28(5) of the 2024/1774 Regulation, which mandates an internal audit of the ICT risk management framework in line with the audit plan and based on risk. The 2024/1773 Regulation (Articles 8-9) addresses contractual arrangements and monitoring, not the audit plan or frequency.
